content_md:
Considering I can think in 5D images I should be able to blyg — and blyg properly.

Now, a voxel is not a box and a pixel is not a square. They have levels, and location, nutrition that becomes a part of the whole. 

A blygxel is not a tweet, it is not even a mini essay. 

No.

A blyg post is humus. identifiable in itself, but left there to decompose, combine, nourish, and be taken up elsewhere.

It does not need to know what it will become.

It only needs to be available to the thicket.

And then the thicket grows with it.
